correctness.rationale: A centered four-level vector is an exact eigenvector at the sparse candidate. Grounded-star Perron eigenvalue plus Cauchy interlacing establishes its global Laplacian gap. The explicitly constructed PSD dual Z=ff^T+nu P has exact edge derivatives and trace D, proving unrestricted upper bound when the critical inequality holds. Equality of the Rayleigh bound forces each spoke and bridge rate; full budget eliminates all chords, including at equality. Outside the inequality, a real k in the precisely derived open interval gives budget-neutral perturbations with strictly positive directional derivatives of both active eigenvalue branches, and the restricted-zero-chord dual excludes all optimizers without a larger-side chord. Full general proof is in RESULT.md; 699 exact checks corroborate finite cases.

value.rationale: The exact edge-support transition is physically motivated by coupling-budget allocation across uneven communities: previously redundant internal clique edges become indispensably active at a precisely identified imbalance threshold. The theorem supplies an all-parameter unique optimizer in a nonempty strict-imbalance range and an exact structural necessity beyond that range, rather than a routine finite instance or a small numerical improvement. No unproved exterior optimal value is asserted.
